description: Unit test class for the BasketWithItemsSpecification, verifying its behavior when evaluating collections of Basket objects based on basket ID and buyer ID criteria.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for BasketWithItemsSpecification.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Verifies that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specific basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Verifies that no baskets are matched when a non-existent basket ID is used.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Verifies that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specific buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Verifies that no baskets are matched when a non-existent buyer ID is used.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a test collection of mock Basket objects with predefined IDs and buyer IDs.
